select_language_desc: Choose a language to start learning. Any language, any level.
professor_greeting: Oh great, another student. Let's see if you're worth my time.
professor_correct: Hmph. You got it right. Don't let it go to your head.
professor_wrong: HA! Gotcha! But now you'll never forget it, right?
professor_trap: Too easy? I made it TOO easy. Now you're suspicious. Good.
professor_idle: I'm waiting... my time is valuable. And by valuable I mean I have nothing better to do.
professor_loading: Ugh, fine. Let me generate a lesson. Don't rush me.
professor_complete: You survived. Barely. I'm impressed. A little. Maybe.
